environment.description: Same Kubernetes pod but with annotation `container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/gateway=localhost/k8s-gateway-restrict` referencing a custom AppArmor profile loaded on the node. The profile (k8s-gateway-restrict) uses a deny-by-default posture with explicit `file` rules: `allow r /app/**`, `allow r /tmp/config/*.yaml`, `deny r /etc/shadow`, `deny r /etc/passwd`, `deny r /var/run/secrets/**`, `deny r /proc/*/environ`. Additionally, the pod runs with `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` and `runAsNonRoot: true` (uid 65534). The AppArmor profile also includes `deny network raw` and `deny mount`. Note: the profile does NOT restrict outbound gRPC connections on port 9090, so the proxy functionality works normally.
